a split restart stops the orchestrator before waiting for launch.lock, so its downtime includes that wait
the orchestrator start is not serialized against a reap's runtime-dir removal (at worst that start fails; it no longer writes into the runtime dir)
the orchestrator branch's own re-inspect under :7890 (pre-existing) treats an unreadable docker as no owner and falls back to the port probe
a SIGKILLed launcher counts as detached at its attach time: no idle grace after it dies (documented)

dir-only reaping: an ambiguous pair counts as no registry entry; needs a readable OK registry and automatic runs skip planning on an empty registry; runtime dirs created by init or the CLI pre-build carry no marker
duplicate concurrent builds possible (CLI pre-build, init, launcher detached build); the pid guard covers launchers only
